accounts.title: A: EMA 20/50 trend (4h)
accounts.rule: Buy when EMA20 crosses above EMA50 and price is above EMA200. Sell on the reverse cross or a 3x ATR stop.

accounts.title: B: Donchian 55 + BTC regime (4h)
accounts.rule: Buy a 55-bar high only when BTC is above its EMA200. Sell on a 20-bar low or a 3x ATR stop.

accounts.title: C: High-frequency RSI dip (1h)
accounts.rule: Experiment aimed at 3-4 trades/day: buy when RSI(7) < 25, sell at RSI > 50, a 1.5x ATR stop or after 12 hours.
